The '''Kol Iben system''' was located one [[Star system|system]] away from the [[Tatoo system]] in the [[Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. It consisted of the [[gas giant]] [[Kol Iben]], its rings, and an unknown number of moons, including the [[Water|estuary]] [[moon]] of [[Trask]].<ref name="Chp10" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|10}}</ref> the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] was tasked to [[Mission to Trask|ferry]] a female [[Querm Rybet]] from [[Tatooine]] to Trask so that she could meet [[Frog Man|her husband]] and [[Reproduction|fertilize]] their [[egg]]s on the [[ocean]] moon.<ref name="Chp10" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The gas giant system was first mentioned in "[[Chapter 10: The Passenger]]," the second episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''.<ref name="Chp10" /> It made its first appearance in the following episode, "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]]."<ref name="Chp11" />
